author: Maxinoxo
body: Hello, I'm Maxinoxo and I have come here to appeal my ban on Avicus. I am a French player that was looking forward into joining a team until I made a big mistake by advertising a different server in chat. I am very sorry for advertising on the Avicus Network. If you could give me a second chance that would mean a lot to me, and I will promise to not do that dumb idea again.

replies.author: Posighdun
replies.body:
Hello Maxinoxo,

Whilst you do seem remorseful, you need to wait a bit longer. Try appealing in the new year. This appeal is denied.

Regards,

Posighdun - Avicus Network Senior Moderator
